reason: SpellContext gains direct_damage_result, a typed DamageInstructionResult carrying what the immediately preceding damage instruction did (CR 608.2c + CR 614.9): Dealt { recipient }, the object its damage was actually dealt to, read by a slotless 'if a [type] is dealt damage this way' rider (Marauding Raptor); AwaitingDelivery { amount, excess, recipient, fight_fought_creature }, accumulating the instruction's result across pauses (CR 616.1, resolution divisions, lifelink/post-loss choices) until the rider resolves; or ContinuationPortion marking a remaining-recipient continuation node. It is serialized inside ResolvedAbility, omitted when absent and defaulted when missing, so an older peer reading a resolution paused between the damage and its rider drops the result and suppresses the rider.
